summary: This plugin integrates a local Ollama provider into DeepSeek Harness, routing requests by rule to local models and providing model management plus a `/ollama` status command.

classificationSuggestion.reason: Evidence from the repository README, package metadata, and description indicates the plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness extension for integrating a local Ollama service: it registers an LLM adapter, exposes Ollama model management and health tools, and offers rule-based local routing with cloud fallback and a `/ollama` status command. The observed functionality is centered on local-model provider integration and operational tooling, not general editing, UI, or non-AI workflow automation.
